model_system: spin-1/2 pyrochlore magnet with dipole-octupole doublets; minimal model Ha for Ce-based pyrochlores / DO-doublet pyrochlores

key_params.Hamiltonian: Ha = sum_<ij>[Jxtilde Sx~_i Sx~_j - Jperp~(Sz~_i Sz~_j + Sy_i Sy_j)] + sum_<<ij>>[J2xz(Sx~_i Sz~_j + Sz~_i Sx~_j)]
key_params.theory: U(1) gauge mean-field with spinon-gauge decomposition and self-consistent parameters chi1, chi2, I1, I2
key_params.order_parameter: all-in all-out antiferromagnetic order in physical Sz
key_params.low-T signature: specific heat C ~ T^3 from gapless U(1) gauge photon
key_params.spinon_dispersion: omega_{±}(k) = [2 Jx~ (lambda - t1 sum_n cos(k·a_n) ± t2 |sum_mu e^{ik·e_mu}|)]^{1/2}

headline_claim: A Coulombic antiferromagnet (pyrochlore AF* state) is stabilized in the Ha phase diagram; it coexists with all-in/all-out order and exhibits an anomalously large T^3 specific heat.
replication_difficulty: medium - requires implementing self-consistent gauge mean-field theory on the pyrochlore/diamond lattice and mapping phase boundaries, but no heavy ab initio computation.
